- Files: long-press on a Recent item opens its folder with the file selected.
- Files: folders with many large images no longer freeze (off-main listing, windowed list).
- Storage: hidden games are counted as apps.
- Keyboard: login chips pick the right username/password fields; new switch for inline autofill; slimmer handle strip; incognito mark.
- Alarm: sound fades out and the system alarm volume is restored after it drains (no loud blip on dismiss).
